p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485762/attempts/600043634274485a8fca1406353e4b51/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f9e7d5aa.py'; code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    seen=set(); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==0 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); cells=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); stack.append((yy,xx))
            r0=min(y for y,x in cells); r1=max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0=min(x for y,x in cells); c1=max(x for y,x in cells)
            depths={}
            for y,x in cells:
                col=grid[y][x]; d=min(y-r0,r1-y,x-c0,c1-x)
                depths.setdefault(col,[]).append(d)
            order=sorted(depths,key=lambda col:sum(depths[col])/len(depths[col]))
            mapping=dict(zip(order,reversed(order)))
            for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=mapping[grid[y][x]]
    return out
'''; open(p,'w').write(code)
